title: Parallel sessions: what each branch holds, seen before the merge
summary: For several sessions on one repository: a read-only report of how far a branch is behind the default branch and which files it shares with the branches of the other worktrees and those pushed from elsewhere, a skill to sync and to tell the other sessions, and a guard that keeps session worktrees out of git.
postInstall: Run ./scripts/parallel-sessions.sh once from a worktree: it fetches the remote's branches, then says what moved under your branch and what the other worktrees and the branches pushed from elsewhere hold.

Fill .worktreeinclude with the ignored files a new worktree needs, or leave it empty. If your sessions run the application, say in CLAUDE.md which ports and local services two sessions cannot both use: docs/conventions/parallel-sessions.md § What a worktree shares.

Nothing is added to CLAUDE.md: the skill and the note PS-2 of the gate carry the rule. To put it in front of every session, copy the line of docs/conventions/parallel-sessions.md § A line for CLAUDE.md.
Only the report and the guard have run, on the kit's own repository; the skill has never been loaded by a session: docs/conventions/parallel-sessions.md § Status.
